scope: Insert absent SectionViewStyle group-1 identifier height, arrow size, arrow extension length, and identifier offset (DXF group 40) from edited typed fields during same-version raw-carrier export.
Preserve occurrence mapping when only a later measurement is edited by inserting absent earlier measurement slots in sequence.
Exercise the sparse offset-only control in ASCII and Binary DXF with typed readback, exact ordered raw-stream comparison, reference closure, and neighboring-record continuity.

implementation.behavior: The SectionViewStyle typed-over-raw overlay now inserts missing group-1 measurement occurrences through the highest edited field. Missing earlier occurrences are filled from current typed/default values. Values must be finite and are formatted with max_digits10 precision.
testCases: Remove all four SectionViewStyle group-1 group-40 tags from generated source DXF; confirm all four typed values default to zero; change only identifier offset to 0.75; export and re-import ASCII and Binary DXF at AC1027; assert three zero slots precede the changed offset.
Compare the complete ordered raw SectionViewStyle carrier, unchanged DetailViewStyle carrier, closed resource references, and following model-space POINT in both encodings.

limitations: Same-source-version DXF typed-field insertion/replay only; no DWG-origin typed serialization or cross-version projection qualification.
No native style-rendering or broader SectionViewStyle semantic-completeness claim follows.
